scenario: LCON.2.7.1 float determinism — addition is NOT rounded to a decimal-friendly value. `0.1 + 0.2 != 0.2999999999999999... ` — specifically `!= 0.3`. The guard `(t.a + t.b) != 0.3` fires, proving the runtime carries the true IEEE 754 result (0.30000000000000004) rather than a tidied 0.3. Pairs with LCON.2.7.1: together they pin the exact bit pattern from both sides.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    a: Float key
    b: Float mutable

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where (t.a + t.b) != 0.3
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
